rv.q: Olney Theatre's production of "A Gentleman's Guide To Love And Murder" is a fast-paced show and will keep laughing the entire time.
A lovely, chucklesome production that isn't a supreme spectacle but makes up ground using fun staging and warm performances.

cn.t: This darkly comedic musical murder romp earns solid marks for its warm performances and inventive staging, delivering consistent chuckles even if it doesn't quite reach spectacular heights.
